div.head: VI Atr 5.4
div.ab: ⁊ se þe þæt nelle, þæt his hade gebyrige, wanige his weorðscipe ægðer ge for Gode ge for worolde.
⁊ se þe þæt nelle, þæt his hade gebyrige, wanige his weorðscipe ægðer ge for Gode ge for worolde.
And se þe þæt nelle þæt his hade gebyrige, wanige his weorðscipe ægðer ge for Gode ge for worolde.
Dagegen wer das ablehnt, was seinem geistlichen Stande ziemt: schwinde sein Ehrenrang so in der Kirche wie im Weltlichen.
But whoever refuses what befits his holy order: let his honour diminish both in the Church and in the world.
And he who will not do what befits his order shall impair both his ecclesiastical and his civil status.
And he who will not act in a manner fitting for his order shall diminish his honor before God and the world.
